title: abrahamaiproject-bit/telemetry-pipeline
body:
# telemetry-pipeline

Ingests GPS pings from fleet vehicles (about 2M events per day) through Kinesis, then Flink, into S3 and ClickHouse.

The output feeds traffic predictions for **Project Atlas**.

## Components
- `ingest/`: Kinesis consumers
- `transform/`: Flink jobs for map-matching and speed aggregation
- `sink/`: ClickHouse writers
